source: ECB getGreenness API, GET, one call per hour
note: Fetched after the fact; the API answers past dates in forecast_mode 'extended_test'. Day of Figure 3 of D2.2. Not used by any experiment.

responses.assumptions: 15-minute energy matching; the specified share of P50 PV is allocated to this workload; no competing demand beyond that allocation, storage, losses or surplus transfer between intervals. Not certified greenness. Variations within each 15-minute interval are not resolved.
